name: Photo-Synth 2 (VST3)
description: A free Windows VST3 instrument: play the colours of four photographs. Colour becomes pitch and timbre on the first photo, the second filters it, the third shapes the envelope, the fourth drives the effects. Virtual-analog voice with a ladder filter, 16-voice pool, seven-module stereo effects rack, Dark Drone engine, MIDI and 24-bit export — all native C++ inside your DAW.
note: Windows VST3 · build 260821.5 · free download · manual and developer kit included.
